Step.Condition: NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/envelope/?.*") AND NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/store/?.*") AND NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/security/?.*") AND NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/minidump/?.*") AND NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/unreal/?.*") AND NOT (proxy.pathsuffix JavaRegex "/api/[0-9]+/csp-report/?.*") AND NOT (request.verb == "OPTIONS")
